checks.scope: 12 horror films from the first three posts
18 more films from a later list (The Lodge rechecked)

meta.note: Availability is from JustWatch and covers Netflix, Prime Video (included with Prime, not the rental store), and Disney+ at no extra cost, plus free-with-ads services as a bonus. Kanopy and Hoopla need a library card. Catalogues change; Netflix and Disney+ may still follow the account's home region even with a VPN.

titles.title: Triangle
titles.notes: 2009 British-Australian film. Still on Prime in the US and UK only.

free.label: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads
Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

titles.title: The Vast of Night
titles.notes: Amazon Original, no longer on US Prime. Rent/buy or Apple TV+ in the US at check date.

titles.title: The Nun
titles.notes: 2018 Conjuring-universe film (not The Nun II). US catalogues are Max/Cinemax, not Netflix/Prime/Disney+.

titles.title: The Witch
titles.notes: Also titled The VVitch. JustWatch slug uses the 2016 US release year.

titles.title: The Exorcism
titles.notes: 2024 film starring Russell Crowe; not The Exorcist. On Disney+ in Latin America.

titles.title: Apostle
titles.notes: Netflix original.

titles.title: Heretic
titles.notes: A24 film with Hugh Grant. US is Hulu/Max add-ons, not Netflix/Prime/Disney+.

titles.title: The Lodge
titles.notes: Often dated 2019; JustWatch lists the 2020 US release. Rechecked 15 Nov 2026.

titles.title: Saint Maud
titles.notes: 2019 UK film; JustWatch lists 2020. Prime Video in the United States only among the three subscription services.

titles.title: The Borderlands
titles.notes: Also released as Final Prayer (JustWatch US title; year listed 2014).

titles.title: The Cycle
titles.notes: Shudder original. Not on Netflix, Prime Video, or Disney+ in any of 139 countries. On Shudder in the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

titles.title: Resident Evil
titles.notes: 2026 Cregger reboot — not the 2002 film, Welcome to Raccoon City, or the 2022 series. Theatres and rent/buy only at check date; not on any subscription catalogue.

titles.title: As Above, So Below
titles.notes: Not on Netflix/Prime/Disney+. Also on Max in some Latin American and European catalogues. Free with ads on Joyn in Germany and Austria.

titles.title: When Evil Lurks
titles.notes: US/Canada free listings are Kanopy/Hoopla only (library card). Also on Shudder/AMC+ in the US, UK, Canada, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

titles.title: Evil Dead
titles.notes: 2013 remake — not the 1981 original or Evil Dead Rise (2023). Netflix in the United States only among the three subscription services. Widely on Max elsewhere.

titles.title: Oddity
titles.notes: US/Canada free listings are Kanopy/Hoopla only. Also on Shudder/AMC+/Hulu in the US.

titles.title: The Medium
titles.notes: US free listing is Hoopla only (library card). Also on Shudder/AMC+ in the US, UK, Canada, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

titles.title: Gonjiam: Haunted Asylum
titles.notes: JustWatch also lists FOUND TV as free-with-ads in a very large number of countries; that footprint could not be independently verified, so treat it cautiously.

free.label: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

titles.title: Longlegs
titles.notes: US is Hulu, not Netflix/Prime/Disney+. US free listing is Kanopy only (library card). BBC iPlayer (UK) and ZDF (Germany) are public-broadcaster free options.

titles.title: Malignant
titles.notes: Not on US Netflix/Prime/Disney+. Also on Max in many European and Latin American catalogues.

titles.title: Fresh
titles.notes: On Disney+ in 69 countries, but not the United States (US is Hulu only).

titles.title: Get Out
titles.notes: Prime Video in 104 countries, but not the United States, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Japan, South Korea, or India. US listings are live-TV apps (YouTube TV, fubo, FXNow).

titles.title: Nosferatu
titles.notes: 2024 Eggers film, not the 1922 original. US is Hulu, not Netflix/Prime/Disney+.

titles.title: Weapons
titles.notes: JustWatch slug uses 2026 but the release year is 2025. US is Max, not Netflix/Prime/Disney+.

titles.title: Bring Her Back
titles.notes: US is Max, not Netflix/Prime/Disney+.

titles.title: The Substance
titles.notes: US is Hulu/MUBI, not Netflix/Prime/Disney+.

titles.title: You Won't Be Alone
titles.notes: Not on Netflix, Prime Video, or Disney+ in any country. Rent/buy in the US, UK, Germany, Australia, and others. Crave in Canada only.

titles.title: IT: Welcome to Derry
titles.credit: Andy Muschietti, Barbara Muschietti, and Jason Fuchs
titles.notes: HBO prequel series. Not on Netflix, Prime Video, or Disney+ in any country. On Max in 83 countries, including the US; Hulu in Japan.

titles.title: Haven
titles.notes: Prime Video in the US, UK, and Switzerland (Guernsey mirrors the UK).

free.label: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

titles.title: Under the Dome
titles.notes: Prime Video in India only among the three subscription services. Also on Paramount+ in the US and SkyShowtime in much of Europe.

titles.title: Castle Rock
titles.notes: Stephen King universe. Netflix in the United States; Prime Video in the Nordics and Portugal.

titles.title: Midnight Mass
titles.notes: Netflix original.

titles.title: Wayward Pines
titles.notes: Disney+ in Australia, Canada, and New Zealand; Prime Video in Italy.

titles.title: Twin Peaks
titles.notes: The original 1990 series, not Twin Peaks: The Return (2017). Prime Video in the UK and Ireland. Free with ads on Arte in Germany, France, Austria, and Switzerland, and on Pluto TV in the US.

titles.title: From
titles.notes: Netflix in the United States; Prime Video in Germany, Austria, India, and several Southeast Asian catalogues.

titles.title: Dark
titles.credit: Baran bo Odar and Jantje Friese
titles.notes: Netflix original.

titles.title: Stranger Things
titles.notes: Netflix original.
